name: FPR helper setAdmin() callable by anyone
summary: The unverified FPR helper contracts exposed setAdmin(address) to any caller; the attacker made itself admin, swept their FPR and LP with remaining(address,address), and sold into the FPR/USDT pair.
notes: Loss is the FPR/USDT pair's USDT outflow, which is what the helpers' swept FPR realised (rule 12).
